fields.name: Paladin

fields.name: Rogue

fields.name: Sorcerer

fields.title: Rats in the Cellar
fields.description: The local tavern keeper's cellar has been overrun by unusually aggressive giant rats and a strange sewer-dwelling creature.
fields.reward_description: 50 GP, free lodging at the Inn for a month, and 2 Potions of Healing.

fields.title: Goblin Ambush on the Gold Road
fields.description: Goblins from the Cragmaw clan have established a barricade along the trade road, raiding merchant caravans bound for the coast.
fields.reward_description: 150 GP pooled by the local Merchants' Guild and a stolen Driftglobe.

fields.title: The Sunken Citadel Crypts
fields.description: Investigate an ancient, partially buried fortress now inhabited by competing kobold and goblin tribes vying for control of a magical tree.
fields.reward_description: 300 GP, a Spell Scroll of Revivify, and a Wand of Magic Missiles.

fields.title: Terror of the Nightwing Coven
fields.description: A green hag coven has kidnapped children from the village to complete a dark ritual under the blood moon.
fields.reward_description: 500 GP, a Ring of Protection, and the favor of the local mayor.

fields.title: The Haunting of Harren Manor
fields.description: Clear out an abandoned noble estate corrupted by a wraith and its restless undead army before the corruption spreads to the nearby town.
fields.reward_description: 800 GP, deed to the cleared property, and a Flame Tongue Longsword.

fields.title: Raid on Fire Giant Stronghold
fields.description: Infiltrate a volcanic fortress where fire giants are enslaving dwarven smiths to forge a colossal siege engine.
fields.reward_description: 2,500 GP, Mithral Plate Armor, and an Amulet of Health.

fields.title: The Young Red Dragon of Mount Sorrow
fields.description: A young red dragon has claimed the summit peak, demanding livestock and gold tribute from nearby settlements under threat of immolation.
fields.reward_description: 5,000 GP worth of coin and jewels from the dragon hoard, plus a Wand of Fireballs.

fields.title: Descent into the Underdark Abyss
fields.description: Venture into the sunless depths to stop a Drow High Priestess who is attempting to open a permanent portal to the Demon Web Pits.
fields.reward_description: 10,000 GP, a Potion of Invisibility, and a Ring of Invisibility.

fields.title: Lich of the Astral Tomb
fields.description: Locate and destroy the phylactery of an ancient dread lich resting within a shattered island drifting in the Astral Plane.
fields.reward_description: 25,000 GP, 3 Rare Spell Scrolls, and a Bag of Holding filled with rare gems.

fields.title: Wrath of the Ancient Blue Dragon
fields.description: Defend the capital city against a assault led by an ancient blue dragon and its storm elemental shock troops.
fields.reward_description: 50,000 GP, royal knighthood, and a Vorpal Sword.

fields.title: The Awakening of Tiamat
fields.description: Prevent the Cult of the Dragon from completing the grand ritual to summon the 5-headed Queen of Dragons into the Material Plane.
fields.reward_description: 100,000 GP, divine favor, and control of the Orb of Dragonkind.
